task: Land the fixes applied live during the 2026-10-16 Kakao deploy so main matches the cluster (APISIX admin key extraction, ambient-label gate, podNetworkCidr allowlist, Kyverno apiCall method drift)

events.summary: Four defects found during the Kakao deploy, three already patched live as uncommitted worktree edits: (a) 08-1 APISIX admin-key extraction never matched the live configmap so the empty-key guard aborted phase 2; (b) the ambient-label gate read pods items[0], which can be a terminating old pod; (c) the APISIX Admin API allowlist hardcoded 10.244.0.0/16 while the Kakao Cilium pool is the legacy 10.0.0.0/16; (d) kyverno-policies stayed OutOfSync because Kyverno defaults apiCall.method to GET. This PR commits (a)-(c) as applied and adds (d) as a source fix. The live apisix-admin-key Secret was overwritten once with placeholders during the deploy and restored from the portal secret copy (best available source, not the original value).

Observed on the live Kakao cluster during the deploy and reported by the orchestrating session (not re-run by this lane): phase 2 aborted at the 08-1 empty-key guard; the Deployment ambient-label gate failed against a terminating old pod; the APISIX ingress controller got 403 ResourceSyncAborted against the 10.244.0.0/16 allowlist on a 10.0.0.0/16 pod pool; the kyverno-policies app stayed OutOfSync on tuning-job-control-plane-node-guard. The fixes were then applied live and phase 2 completed.

Admin key now comes from the existing apisix-admin-key Secret, then an awk parse of the bootstrap configmap, and values containing { or $ are rejected as placeholders. Ambient label read from the Deployment pod template. New chart value podNetworkCidr (default 10.244.0.0/16) feeds both APISIX allowlists, passed by provision-kakao.sh (POD_NETWORK_CIDR) and 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh. R126/R126b read the default from values.yaml. method: GET set explicitly on the tuning-job-control-plane-node-guard apiCall (D1) instead of widening ignoreDifferences, which would mask real drift in every rule context.
